    Begench Garahanov

    GARAHANOV BEGENCH Born October 19, 1994

    Master’s candidate at Waseda University Graduate School of Social Sciences, specializing in Policy Science. Applied Chemistry engineer turned policy scientist, currently working as a Technical Expert at Apple Japan. My mission is to bridge engineering, econometrics, and global leadership to solve complex business and policy challenges.

    Profile

    I bring together a rare combination of skills: an engineering foundation from Tokai University’s Department of Applied Chemistry, quantitative modeling expertise from Waseda University’s graduate program, and hands-on international leadership experience from both ETUT National University and Apple Japan. I am currently pursuing CFA Level I certification to further integrate financial analysis into my toolkit.

    My academic work focuses on large-scale data analysis using Python and Stata for mathematical modeling and policy prediction. At Apple Japan, I lead team performance analysis and mentoring in a multilingual, multicultural environment — identifying challenges from concrete data and driving processes that maximize outcomes.

    Core Strengths

    • Quantitative Analysis — Econometric modeling, large-scale data analysis, policy prediction
    • Engineering Background — Applied Chemistry, energy systems foundation
    • Global Leadership — Multilingual team management, cross-cultural communication, mentoring
    • Technical Skills — Python, Stata, data-driven strategy formulation
    • Languages — Japanese (N1), English (TOEIC 960 / TOEFL iBT 113), Russian (Proficiency Level 1)
